title: A natural benefic occupies the 7th house

text.en: A natural benefic sits in the 7th house, the house of marriage. Classical texts read this as support for married life and for the spouse's nature.
text.impact: Married life tends to have ease in it: a supportive partner, and a household that runs on goodwill.

title: The Sun, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu occupies the 7th house

text.en: The Sun, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu sits in the 7th house. Classical texts associate a malefic here with strain in married life, to be weighed together with the 7th lord and Venus rather than on its own. Mars in the 7th is judged separately as Chevvai dosha.
text.impact: Married life may ask for patience, and for give and take on both sides. This is read as friction to work through, not as a prediction about the marriage itself.

title: Saturn aspects the 7th house

text.impact: Saturn here is read as later rather than not at all. Marriage often comes at a more settled age, and tends to be taken seriously when it does.

title: Venus, the karaka of marriage, occupies the 7th house

text.en: Venus, the karaka of marriage, sits in the 7th house itself. The classical dictum karako bhava nashaya holds that a karaka in its own bhava can harm that bhava's matters; how strongly it applies is debated, so this is noted rather than scored.
text.impact: The significator of marriage sits in the house of marriage. Practitioners differ on whether this helps or hinders, so it is noted rather than counted either way.
